name: zanker-ux-strategy
description: Translate audience and goals into task flows, hierarchy and design decisions.

workflow.instruction: Define actor, entry point, primary success path, exception states and high-impact actions.
Map steps and remove needless decisions; preserve discoverable critical information.
Express design principles aligned with product stage and audience.

acceptance: Path exists for recovery from errors
Metrics are associated with user outcomes
fallback: Document a minimal decision flow rather than inventing user evidence.
